subject.title: Traveling Politician Project (In Progress) & NASPO Catalog Improvements & MMIS AI Setup
details: Traveling Politician Project (In Progress): Set up project structure and loaded state capitals data with coordinates. Implemented Haversine formula for distance calculation. Built greedy algorithm to find a route starting from Des Moines, Iowa, visiting all state capitals, and ending in Washington, DC. Currently testing the route output and preparing for optimization. Plan to add 2-opt improvement and route visualization.

NASPO Catalog Project (Improvements): Split single search box into two separate fields: Vendor search and Product/Description search. Updated price display format to show commas and two decimal places (e.g., $6,000.00). Used Django humanize template filters for better formatting.
MMIS AI - Electronic Claim Entry & Submission Portal: Downloaded and ran Chao's PATO application locally. Reviewed the database schema and C4 model diagrams.

notes: Haversine formula calculates great-circle distance between two points on Earth using latitude and longitude.
The greedy algorithm selects the nearest unvisited capital at each step.
2-opt optimization will improve the route by swapping path segments to reduce total distance.
Django humanize filters provide human-readable number formatting without custom code.
plan_next_week: Complete Traveling Politician Project with 2-opt optimization and route visualization.
